DIGI is an active brand name for unrelated technology businesses, including Teraoka weighing and retail systems and Digi International communications products. The undifferentiated queue identity cannot be assigned safely.

No authoritative manufacturer-owned domain or explicit official-parent source was found that establishes DINANSI's current identity and product scope. Secondary listings are insufficient for BRAND_SAFE.

profiles.shortDescription: DirectLOGIC publishes manufacturer information for industrial automation and control and industrial software. The published range includes Micro PLCs, Brick PLCs, and Modular PLCs. Exact configuration and supply status are checked for each request.
